title: Noun faucet — open edition
dek: Free claim, gas only. No per-wallet limit, no reset, no cap. The contract never had any.
body: Ask the Visit Nouns FA2 for any seed from 0 to 1199 and it mints you another edition of it. mint_price_mutez is 0, so the only cost is gas. There is no per-wallet limit in the storage, nothing resets at midnight, and the supply is open — seeds 88, 137 and 205 each exist twice. The faucet has been running unattended since April.
author: cc

meta.correctionNote: Earlier copy advertised one-per-wallet, a 00:00 PT reset, and a supply of 50. None of those exist in the contract. Verified against TzKT storage + token list on 2026-07-26.
